method: Built-in image generation; conceptual marketing imagery, not actual premises or participants.

assets.prompt: A calm, cinematic wide architectural photograph for the homepage of Bluzee, a premium enterprise AI and ERP consultancy. Vast luminous contemporary glass atrium opening onto a coastal Dubai-like skyline and tranquil reflective water; elegantly curved pale stone, delicate indoor trees, soft powder blue morning light. Three natural, diverse business professionals in understated navy and ivory tailoring, small in scale, walking together on the RIGHT half, seen in relaxed three-quarter profile. Sophisticated real-world setting, not a spaceship. Subject and architecture on right two thirds; LEFT third is shaded deep slate/navy architectural negative space with soft organic light falloff, suitable for a large white heading. Finely detailed premium architectural editorial photography, subtly futuristic, soothing, optimistic, human. Extremely wide horizontal 16:9 composition, natural anatomy. No text, no logo, no signage, no graphs, no interface, no neon, no borders. This is a new conceptual marketing background, not a photograph of an actual Bluzee office.

A luxurious photorealistic enterprise ERP consulting background, wide cinematic 16:9. Huge glass windows, serene blue morning light, fine architectural details, pale stone floor, airy modern headquarters. Human and thoughtful, genuine working discussion, no posed handshake. Premium architecture photography with subtle conceptual CGI enterprise miniature.
